evidence: All modules reside at root level (max_directory_depth: 1)
High average fan-out (3.86) with cross-module dependencies between most files
No clear boundaries or abstractions for layers, ports, or components
Main scripts (example.py, cube_reconstruction.py) import and use multiple modules directly without intermediate layers
Functions defined at module level without clear encapsulation or formal service interfaces
Dependencies form a tangled web rather than directional flow (e.g., camera.py uses processor & transformers, but processor and transformers have no dependencies)
risks: Tight coupling between modules reduces reusability and testability
Lack of separation of concerns makes maintenance difficult as system grows
Absence of explicit interfaces increases risk of circular dependencies
Testing requires mocking many low-level dependencies due to direct imports
